title: tc-progress-tracker
description: A checklist with a progress bar.

heading.description: The heading, and the progress bar's name

steps.description: The checklist. Each step's `done` flag is where it starts; when the flags change, the tracker follows them

done.description: Ids of the ticked steps; unset, the tracker keeps its own

defaultDone.description: Ids ticked at first when `done` is unset – defaults to the steps marked `done`

autoPlay.description: Ticks the open steps one after another, then starts over

interval.description: Pause between two automatic steps, in ms

readonly.description: A status list: every step shows its state as text, nothing can be ticked and auto play stays off

doneStyle.description: How done steps look: "strike" draws a line through them, "plain" only grays them

fit.description: The card's width: "compact" (up to 360 px), "wide" (up to 560 px) or "fill" (no maximum)

state.description: "failed" or "pending": shown in place of the check and in words; the step doesn't count as done and can't be ticked

disabled.description: Can't be ticked or cleared – it stays in the tab order, dimmed and announced as unavailable

readonly.description: Shows its state as text, not as a checkbox

ProgressStepState.description: A step the app drives: "failed" (it went wrong) or "pending" (under way)
